Command-line tools

Aurora's own programs and helpers

CommandWhat it does
aurora-aiAurora AI from the terminal (the ask and why helpers use it).
aurora-assistantThe Aurora Assistant. --focus, --ask TEXT, --file PATH [--summarize], --writing.
aurora-autostartStarts the apps registered in XDG autostart, honoring OnlyShowIn, NotShowIn, Hidden and TryExec.
aurora-clipboardClipboard history store (fed by wl-paste --watch).
aurora-devhubDev Hub.
aurora-filesFiles. Takes folders or locations (aurora-files ~/Downloads, aurora-files smb://nas/share).
aurora-gamehubGame Hub.
aurora-greeterThe login screen (run by greetd).
aurora-idleScreen blanking, locking and suspend on inactivity (started by the session).
aurora-idle-suspendSuspends on inactivity when allowed (battery or plugged in).
aurora-installerOpens the installer in the live session.
aurora-lockLock the screen.
aurora-lookWrites the GTK stylesheet imports for the chosen window style.
aurora-quicklookQuick Look a file: aurora-quicklook FILE.
aurora-sessionStarts a desktop session (used by the login screen): Aurora (Wayfire) or Aurora Compatibility (labwc).
aurora-settingsSettings. --page NAME opens a page (for example display, storage).
aurora-shellThe desktop shell: top bar, dock, desktop, Spotlight, notifications. With a command, talks to the running shell (see Shell commands).
aurora-taskmanagerTask Manager.
aurora-wayfire-configRenders ~/.config/aurora/wayfire.ini from your settings.
aurora-welcomeThe first-run tour.
askAsk Aurora AI for a command: ask "find big files"; it runs the command only if you answer y.
whyExplain an error: make 2>&1 | why.
portopWhich process holds a port, and stop it with one key.
pkgtuiSearch, install, remove and upgrade apt, Flatpak and Snap packages in one terminal UI.

#Administrator helper

/usr/libexec/aurora-admin is the one audited program that performs privileged actions for Settings (firewall rules, the login manager's automatic login, the battery limit…), through polkit, which asks for the administrator password.
